hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
msg = data.get('message', '').lower()
feature_verbs = ['build', 'create', 'implement', 'add', 'develop', 'make']
feature_nouns = ['feature', 'page', 'screen', 'flow', 'section', 'modal', 'form', 'calendar', 'notes', 'meal', 'chart', 'dashboard', 'view', 'list', 'tracker']
has_verb = any(v in msg for v in feature_verbs)
has_noun = any(n in msg for n in feature_nouns)
if has_verb and has_noun:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'UserPromptSubmit', 'additionalContext': 'WORKFLOW REMINDER: This looks like a feature request. Follow the feature workflow: Plan -> Design -> Build -> Review -> Deploy. Use /feature if not already in the workflow. Do not write any code until Stage 2 (Design) is approved.'}}))
"
